howto: Press Play: the bird hovers until your first tap.
Tap, click or press Space to flap. Each flap lifts the bird.
Fly through the gaps between the pipes. Each pipe is 1 point, a star 2, a feather 3.
tips: Short, steady taps beat big panicky ones.
A feather gives you a shield that saves you from one crash.
Three close shaves in a row also earn a shield.
The pipes speed up as your score climbs, up to about 30 points.
Sprint mode ends after 20 pipes and pays a bonus for every close shave.

controls.keyboard: Space or Up arrow to flap. P or Esc pauses.

difficulty: An adaptive curve: the pipes scroll faster with every point until about 30. Gale mode makes every pipe sway up and down; Sprint mode is a 20-pipe dash.

cheats.effect: Ghost bird: fly through pipes and bounce off the ground
Wide gaps: every pipe gap is 40% taller
Slow motion: the whole sky runs at 60% speed

features.one-tap-start: Play, then one tap flaps and starts the run
features.instant-restart: Play Again, a tap on the results card or Space goes straight back to the hovering bird
features.best-score-badge: BEST under the score at the top of the screen, and on the title
features.tutorial-card: Get-ready card with a tapping finger; the first run explains stars, feathers and shields
features.results: Game Over card with score, best, medal, feathers and rank
